Vertical 9:16 cinematic feature-anime KEY ART, painted pastel-watercolor environments, fine ink edges and tactile paper grain. Contemporary 2026 South Indian UNIVERSITY romance, sophisticated adult scale, premium theatrical framing. Warm apricot sunshafts, dusty-blue and teal shadows, ivory and restrained rose accents. Deep layered perspective, soft near foreground, crisp focal subject. Modern architectural materials rendered as watercolor, never a photograph. No phones, ribbons, nursery furniture, school posters, balloons, watermarks or extra readable text.

Cinematic wide low-angle opening frame, camera one metre high and eight metres away, 24mm perspective without fisheye. A monumental contemporary South Indian UNIVERSITY academic building: pale architectural concrete, terracotta rainscreen fins, double-height glazing, broad grey stone entrance steps and a deeply recessed six-metre-high rectangular portal. One pair of oversized matte teal METAL pivot doors, smooth solid leaves, slim vertical bronze handles, no old timber panels. Beyond is a vast contemporary university lecture theatre with a nine-metre-high ceiling, acoustic oak slat baffles, slim recessed linear lights, double-height LEFT glazing, tiered curved rows of full-sized upholstered dusty-teal seats with pale-oak writing desks, one clear central aisle, a blank charcoal presentation screen and a minimalist lectern. Architecture feels newly designed, spacious and unmistakably university-scale. No chalkboard, historic beams, school desks, chandeliers or wedding decor. Teal doors CLOSED, interior hidden. Full portal plus adjacent enormous glazing and terracotta fins visible. Broad steps lead straight toward doors. Dramatic diagonal upper-left afternoon sunbeam, deep cool porch shade, luminous painted air. Clearly LEVITATING near-camera academic objects: one open blank cream notebook at LOWER LEFT, 60cm from lens and 20 percent frame width; a blank burgundy softcover book tilted at MID-RIGHT, 15 percent frame width; two separate curled cream sheets at different depths; one matte mechanical pencil. Five independent objects, partly cropped, softly out of focus at nearest edges, convincing shadows and thickness. Keep the central opening and title clear. No tiny confetti substitute, strings or supports. No people and NO text anywhere. Retain a grand animated-film composition and foreground depth, not a small classroom entrance.
